notes: Six static slides of exactly 6.000s each. Titles are Chinese at 96px (Microsoft YaHei Bold), English subtitles at 52px, body lines at 46px, all >=46px tall at 720p so they stay ~11px tall in a 1280/5-wide tile. Every card carries both scripts on the same line-group, which is the hard case for OCR tile sizing: at 46px the CJK glyphs are 46x46 px, still legible after a 4x downscale, illegible after 8x.
